design_record: docs/plans/SPATIAL_REPRESENTATION72_V1.md (frozen with this protocol, before any candidate is trained)
server: LabServer63 (main; user instruction 2026-11-03: run on 63 only after the concurrent ~/TransGI-Reproduction job has completely finished); root ~/rest_cmp72; WL68 (~/rest_repr68), WL71 (~/rest_cover71) and WL71A (~/rest_drift_smoke) are read-only inputs
common_contract: K x = B x + O^T T A ((1-beta) x); fixed WL68 net_all_5902 A/O; T >= 0, sum_j T = mass in (0,1); unchanged B/beta; 16 in / 64 out bins
training_data: WL71 S16 (slots 0-15), rest and pt0, mean of fitting replicas 0-3 (fit71.Problem, ~/rest_cover71/fit_targets71.pt); WL68 objective J (fit71.objective)

optimizer.algorithm: Adam (0.9, 0.999, 1e-8), full batch, float32, TF32 off
optimizer.convergence: WL68 last-decile rule (<1 %) on the optimised loss

candidates.A: WL59 P W+UV, group 'net' (A/O fixed), init P_590x + fixed A/O (as WL71 D1); loss J + lambda * L_sym with lambda = 1 (fixed, same relative-error normalisation as J; no search); L_sym = mean over (geometry, training source, non-identity exact symmetry, channel) of the relative squared error of the angle-integrated collided response on native receivers; symmetries: rest D4 x z-flip (15 non-identity), pt0 D4 (7 non-identity; images built by the unchanged geometry code, fit72.py geoms)
candidates.B: RSK (rsk72.py): phi_loc (27->96->96->24), phi_far (28->96->96->24, last bias -7), phi_m (20->64->24, last bias 1.1); position-free descriptors; 128-neighbour local + 240-cell far relations; WL59 per-channel distance prior on local weights; trained from torch.manual_seed(seed); loss J

confirmation.geometry_rule: among WL57 test/confirmation/validation poses never used for any probe reference (cf0, cf1, te0-te3, va0, va1), the pose whose dent centre is farthest (rest xy) from every exact-symmetry image of the pt0 dent centre ((+-5, +-5) mm); tie (te2 and va1, 14.6 mm) broken by the larger dent depth -> te2 (depth 5.5 mm, radius 22.5 mm, centre (-17.5, 12.5) mm); te2 is not a symmetry image of rest or pt0
confirmation.te2_geometry: archived WL57 geometry LabServer69:~/rest_wl57/data/geometry/te2.pt (sha256 06b4d900bc229d06de534f9e80bcf2c1568eaefdc22015abdaaa23bc45b98116), copied to ~/rest_cmp72/inputs/geometry_te2.pt; identity gate: fresh LabServer63 build equal in xyz, rest_xyz, area, node, pair, prior, parent, src, dst, graph
confirmation.port_rule: on the slot face, ports sorted by (round(3-D rest distance to target, 1e-9 m), index); first admissible: min over bins of (1-beta) >= 0.5 at rest AND te2; top/bottom ports >= 0.01 m from every slab side; >= 0.01 m (rest 3-D distance, same face) from every exact-symmetry image (D4 x z-flip, face mapped accordingly) of every port with any WL66/WL68/WL71 probe reference (slots 0-15, 20-27) and from every previously chosen confirmation port; never equal to such a port or image; no reselection
confirmation.references: unchanged WL66/WL68/WL71 estimator and packet gates; 32M photons per packet; rest and te2 x slots 40-47 x 16 bins x 4 replicas = 1024 packets; seeds 723000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (rest 0, te2 1); chunk rule and OOM fallback as WL71 (probes71.trace); walker: the WL57 fast walker unless ~/rest_walker71c/validated.json (status PASSED, written by the separately validated WL71C rework) exists when generation starts, in which case its module path is used and recorded per packet
confirmation.precision: abs matrices: coarse signal/SE >= 10 in every channel; deformation (te2 - rest) matrices: >= 3; a group needs >= 4 of 8 qualified matrices or it is UNMEASURED

development_groups: S16_rest / S16_pt0 (replicas 4-7), FIN71_rest / FIN71_cf2 / DEF71_cf2 (WL71 final ports, now development), H3_cf3 (WL68 cf3 slots 4-7)

evaluation.estimators: eval68 unchanged (unbiased cross-replica Grams, jackknife upper 95 %, worst channel)
evaluation.per_source: per-matrix coarse / fine16 / contrast upper bounds and 1 cm flux concentration
evaluation.full_field: eval68.extended (WL59 historical fields) and eval68.passivity for every candidate (RSK through its Transport-compatible adapter)
evaluation.oracle: LABELLED ORACLE: admissible T for the fixed A/O fitted on confirmation replica 0, scored on replicas 1-3 (eval68 split); a representability bound, never a candidate
evaluation.cost: parameter count, runtime state size (stored coefficient floats per geometry), training seconds per step (contended, 2 lanes), coefficient build time and 64-light application time per geometry

decision.metrics: for a run X: c_X = max over CONF_rest and CONF_te2 of the worst-channel upper bound of con_coarse; a_X likewise for abs_coarse; e_X = CONF_DEF worst-channel upper bound of abs_coarse
decision.baseline: c_D = min over D1_5901, D1_5902 of c; a_D likewise
decision.improves: candidate improves iff BOTH seeds have c <= 0.8 c_D and a <= 0.8 a_D
decision.superior: X superior to Y iff max over X seeds of c <= 0.8 x min over Y seeds of c AND the same for a AND max over X seeds of e <= 1.2 x min over Y seeds of e
decision.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE if confirmation groups are UNMEASURED, leakage is detected or a reference gate fails; INCOMPARABLE if a candidate fails its implementation gates (linearity, zero input, positivity, passivity, finiteness) - the valid candidate's improvement is reported; else both improve: A SUPERIOR / B SUPERIOR if superior, otherwise BOTH IMPROVE WITHOUT CLEAR WINNER; exactly one improves and is superior to the other: that SUPERIOR; exactly one improves but not superior: INCONCLUSIVE; neither improves: NEITHER IMPROVES
decision.quality_gates: WL59 thresholds per group are reported separately (pass/fail); they do not change the comparative verdict
decision.not_claimed: differences are attributable to the complete designs; no adoption

prohibited: candidate tuning on confirmation or development results

execution.wrapper: run72.sh: waits until no process of the TransGI-Reproduction job exists and the GPU has no compute process for 10 consecutive minutes, then runs the dev smoke chain (root ~/rest_cmp72_dev: 0.5M-photon packets, 40-step fits, 5-iteration oracle; pipeline check only, no metric used) and, only if it completes, the evidence chain (root ~/rest_cmp72); one detached server process, no session dependency
execution.frozen_before: any candidate training or confirmation reference; the dev smoke runs after the freeze, so any dev failure fix is a disclosed pre-evidence amendment
